verdict.rationale: Grok Imagine provides image generation and editing from natural-language prompts, with docs confirming editing of up to 5 source images, new aspect ratios, and dedicated image models (grok-imagine-image-2.0), plus overview docs explicitly stating users can 'create images and video with Grok Imagine.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reviews specifically of image generation/editing quality (community evidence focuses mainly on coding/text tasks, not images).
